question: What chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes at this point?
premises: The text identifies itself as Aṃśumān Kāśyapa
The subject is the characteristics of Vināyaka
inference: This marks the end of the forty-eighth chapter on Vināyaka's characteristics in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter, on the characteristics of Vināyaka, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
